CustomField.description:
Term numbers that are considered to be part of Double Term Semester for PE Pathway stored in comma-separated values. ex: 1,2 indicates that PE Pathway with My Term = 1 or 2 which are linked with the Program Enrolment of this Program Plan should be considered a Double Term Semester.
Special values: -1 : Indicates that all the related PE Pathway should be considered Double Term Semester, 0 or Empty : Indicates that all the related PE Pathway should NOT be considered Double Term Semester
If using Special Values, please do not put other values in the field (ie: do not put -1,1 ) to avoid confusion.
